**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is planning a get-together with friends.

[EVENT] User is looking for help finding a good venue for a brunch spot.

[PREFERENCE] User needs a venue that can accommodate a group of 5-6 people.

[FACT] User met friends from college at a new brunch spot that just opened and found it amazing.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant expressed excitement about helping the user find a brunch spot.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on discovering a new brunch spot they loved.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant asked for more information to provide tailored recommendations, including location, cuisine, budget, dietary restrictions, and seating preferences.

[PREFERENCE] User is open to trying new spots and does not have a specific cuisine in mind.

[PREFERENCE] User's budget is flexible but ideally around $20-30 per person.

[PREFERENCE] User has a friend who is gluten-free, which needs to be considered.

[PREFERENCE] User does not need a private room and prefers a casual setting.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided several brunch spot recommendations: The Breakfast Club, Bistro 5, The Farmhouse, Eggs, and Café Mosaic.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that The Breakfast Club has a fun atmosphere and seasonal menu with prices around $15-$25 per person.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant described Bistro 5 as a modern bistro with creative, farm-to-table dishes and a separate gluten-free menu for around $20-$30 per person.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant characterized The Farmhouse as a rustic spot focusing on locally sourced ingredients with gluten-free options and prices around $20-$30 per person.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted that Eggs is a trendy spot with creative breakfast dishes and gluten-free options, with prices around $15-$25 per person.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant described Café Mosaic as a cozy café with international-inspired dishes and gluten-free options, with prices around $15-$25 per person.

[PREFERENCE] User expressed interest in Bistro 5 and The Farmhouse.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided details about gluten-free options and outdoor seating at Bistro 5 and The Farmhouse.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] At Bistro 5, gluten-free options include a separate gluten-free menu, gluten-free bread, and pasta.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Bistro 5 has a small outdoor patio area with around 10-15 seats, first-come, first-served.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] At The Farmhouse, gluten-free options include gluten-free pancakes, waffles, sandwiches, and gluten-free beer and cocktails.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Farmhouse has a spacious outdoor area with plenty of seating, surrounded by gardens.

[PREFERENCE] User decided to go
